headline: Short-period S junk today — glassy but forgettable.
today: Swell's a weak 1.2-1.8ft at 4-5s from due south and the wind is onshore and building to 14mph SSE by afternoon. Dawn is the only semi-clean look and even that's marginal. Save your energy for tomorrow.

daysToWatch.note: Prime SSE angle at 1.6-1.9ft with light dawn and morning wind — glassy. Small but clean; a proper log session if you catch it before the afternoon onshore.
N offshore in the morning grooms a 1.4-1.6ft prime-angle swell. Clean but tiny, log only.
